text:
emily (recruiter): Heads-up 00: Noor Kaur (L2 UX) interview day Thu 2026-10-14. Candidate requests a sensory-friendly room, one 20min wellness break mid-day, and that we avoid surprise schedule changes. She also needs to leave by 14:00 PT for childcare. Can folks accommodate?

drew (hiring mgr): We can compress panels. Proposed plan: 09:30-10:00 remote screen, 10:30-11:00 paired design session (onsite), 11:30-12:30 final panel. That ends before 13:30 which gives buffer. Can interviewers do 30/60 minute blocks?

maya (people-ops): Yes we can. We'll block a quiet room and add a wellness break at 11:00-11:20. Also will add a calendar note about early departure and ask interviewers to keep debriefs to 15m. Any dietary restrictions for lunch voucher?

care-team: Candidate indicates lactose intolerance and prefers low-noise spaces. We can provide a "quiet interview" sign, noise-cancelling headphones, and a low-sensory snack box (gluten-free, dairy-free options).

it-support-bot: Quick Q: does Noor need a loaner device? We can reserve a Chromebook or Mac. We can also provide a USB-C to MagSafe adapter if she brings a Mac. ETA for imaging: 24h.
emily (recruiter): Noor will bring her own MacBook but asked for a charger and a short HDMI adapter. Please reserve adapter + power strip.

facilities-bot: Conf E (north wing) blocked 10:15-13:30 and marked as "Low Sensory". Visitor parking V3 reserved 10:00-14:30. Front desk to pre-print badge and a note to greet candidate with minimal announcements.

travel-team: If candidate needs transit reimbursement, we cover rideshare or public transit up to $50. Please advise candidate to keep receipts and submit to expenses@redwood.com with code HIRING-REIMB.

front-desk: We'll hold the loaner adapter and the noise-cancelling headphones at reception. Also we'll provide a printed schedule with interviewer names and room numbers, and a small laminated "quiet interview" sign.

drew (hiring mgr): Two operational asks: 1) Add this to the invite: "Candidate requests no surprise schedule changes; please join or send regrets 5m before your slot." 2) Add Zoom fallback link and disable auto-recording.

maya (people-ops): Done 1: I've updated the calendar invite with the note and Zoom fallback. Also attached a one-paragraph privacy blurb for the candidate: "We only use interview recordings with consent; none will be recorded for this loop."

emily (recruiter): Noor just messaged: "Thanks — the 09:30 start works. I may need 10 extra minutes between sessions to practice grounding exercises; can we schedule that in if possible?"

care-team: We can add a 10min buffer after the remote screen: schedule becomes 09:30-09:55 remote, 09:55-10:05 buffer, 10:15-10:45 paired session. We'll send a short accommodations note to interviewers.

it-support-bot: Adapter + power strip reserved. Loaner Mac held as backup. Pickup instruction: "Ask reception for Noor Kaur's adapter pack. Return to reception before leaving."

emily (recruiter): Calendar updated and invites sent. I added a private note for interviewers: "Candidate uses grounding breaks; please avoid surprises and keep debrief <15m." Also included expense & parking details.

drew (hiring mgr): Appreciated. Quick reminder to interviewers to follow the schedule; I'll do a 5m kickoff to set expectations.

candidate-bot: Noor replied: "Thank you, I appreciate the accommodations. I'll bring my charger and will use the adapter if needed. See you Thu."

maya (people-ops): Final checklist posted in invite: 
- Conf E (Low Sensory) reserved
- Noise-cancelling headphones + adapter at reception
- Visitor parking V3 reserved
- Wellness break 09:55-10:05 added
- Lunch voucher with dairy-free option
- Zoom fallback link & recording disabled

front-desk: We'll greet Noor and hand over package. Closing thread 1: reopen if travel or timing changes.
